integrity: One mathematically stated claim about two asymptotic rates and the isotropic exact witness. Direct projector identity, angular Fourier law, ergodic theorem and finite-rank positive transfer operator establish it; computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 2-by-2 SPD matrix, iid standard Gaussian rank-one sketches, symmetric deterministic nonexact initialization; inverse-matrix error only, not optimization-iterate rates; no moving Hessians, adaptive sketches, blocks or dimensions above two.
title: Exact annealed and quenched Gaussian-sketch BFGS rates in the plane
